group.title: Museum audio guide vacancy
group.passage:
CITY MUSEUM — TEMPORARY CONTENT EDITOR
Twelve-week contract, starting September 2

We are seeking an editor to adapt exhibition research into clear, engaging scripts for our new audio guide. The editor will work with curators to select key facts and with recording staff to ensure that each script fits a two-minute track. This is an editing role, not a voice-performance position.

Applicants must have experience writing for a general audience. Knowledge of local history is desirable but not essential; research materials will be supplied. The successful candidate must attend planning meetings at the museum on Tuesdays, but may work remotely on other days. Equipment for remote work is not provided.

Send a résumé and two writing samples by July 18. Please do not send audio recordings. Shortlisted applicants will be asked to shorten a sample exhibition text as a paid assessment. Interviews will take place during the first week of August. Applications from people who can work only at weekends cannot be considered.
group.passageZh:
市立博物館：短期內容編輯
十二週合約，九月二日開始

徵求編輯，將展覽研究改寫成清晰生動的新語音導覽稿。編輯將與策展人挑選重點，並與錄音人員合作，確保每篇符合兩分鐘音軌長度。這是編輯職務，不是配音工作。

應徵者須有為一般讀者寫作的經驗。熟悉地方歷史者佳，但非必要，會提供研究資料。錄取者星期二須到館開規劃會議，其他日可遠距工作。館方不提供遠距設備。

請最遲於七月十八日寄送履歷及兩篇寫作樣本，不要寄錄音。通過初選的應徵者將受邀精簡一篇展覽文字，並可獲得測驗報酬。面試在八月第一週。僅能週末工作者無法列入考量。
